name: news-india
description: News India bilingual news portal — Phase 1 with JSON demo data

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @news-india/api" "npm run dev -w @news-india/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @news-india/api && npm run build -w @news-india/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @news-india/api
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @news-india/api
